messages:
leo_support: Heads-up ticket SUP-9023 from Meridian Health. They see intermittent JSON parse failures when streaming chat -> fncall -> structured webhook; payloads sometimes arrive concatenated or truncated.

jade_sales: Meridian is targeting an internal launch Friday. this is blocking. they asked for either a patch or a documented workaround.

tess_pm: Thanks. Can we get an example trace? important to know if coalescing happens at our proxy or on the client.

leo_support: Minimal trace attached in ticket: occasionally POST body is `}{` or final object truncated. Affects ~1-3% under load.

omar_eng: Likely causes: TCP coalescing at proxy, runtime flush timing, or our webhook proxy not splitting frames. Quick ideas: (1) emit an explicit frame delimiter token after each logical frame, (2) buffer and only forward complete JSON objects, (3) document client-side defensive parsing.

tess_pm: Triage options and tradeoffs?

reena_prodops: Hosted canary possible quickly; Dedicated/private needs packaging. Any change to payload should be opt-in with rollout notes.

omar_eng: Quick implementation: add small separator token `
--rwd-frame--
` after each logical frame and teach proxy to split on it. Prototype ~1 day, canary + dashboards ~3 days, backport ~2 days. Low perf risk.

tess_pm: Acceptance for a canary: <0.2% concatenated/truncated POSTs in canary region, integration test with slow downstream, monitor `webhook.frame_errors` metric, rollback plan + opt-in header.

jade_sales: I'll tell Meridian we aim for a canary in 72h and give them a parsing snippet as a stopgap.

leo_support: Mark SUP-9023 in-progress and link GH-4350. Will attach customer logs and contact info.

omar_eng: Starting prototype now, will post PR with smoke tests and a measurement hook.

tess_pm: Decision: run Hosted canary with separator-splitting approach; re-evaluate if perf/regression shows up. Keep thread brief for updates.
